label: PLAN-R2-02
command_argv:
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
root=Path.cwd()
task=root/'handoffs/evaluator_executor/HNA-RESEARCH-ADMISSION-20261116'
baseline=json.loads((task/'evidence/planning_r2_baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==baseline['head']
assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in baseline['source_hashes'].items())
contract=(task/'CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
plan=yaml.safe_load((task/'VALIDATION_PLAN.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
acs=set(re.findall(r'^### (AC-\d{2})',contract,re.M))
assert acs=={'AC-01','AC-02','AC-03','AC-04','AC-05','AC-06','AC-07'}
assert set(a for check in plan['checks'] for a in check['ac'])==acs
assert len(plan['checks'])==6
assert plan['task_id']=='HNA-RESEARCH-ADMISSION-20261116'
assert all(c['mandatory'] and c['expected_exit_code']==0 and isinstance(c['command'],list) and (root/c['cwd']).is_dir() for c in plan['checks'])
compile(plan['checks'][1]['command'][-1],'<planned-test-command>','exec')
assert 'suite.countTestCases() > 0' in plan['checks'][1]['command'][-1]
assert 'Contract state: DRAFT_CONTRACT' in contract
assert hashlib.sha256((task/'CONTRACT.r1_小包草案.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='4bbfe8043f7762afa6b2cffed2e38060f3603f79b9864f48fe95cfa0654680b1'
assert hashlib.sha256((task/'VALIDATION_PLAN.r1.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='242cd92d28cfac4245e89a5713d0feece0e1956d14ae7e59a783e236cd521088'
links=[]
for path in [task/'CONTRACT.md',task/'EVALUATION_RULES.md',root/'handoffs/真实资料到实际选购判断_长执行包_20261116.md']:
 content=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 assert not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in content.splitlines())
 for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',content):
  if ref.startswith(('https:','http:','#')): continue
  target=(path.parent/ref.split('#')[0]).resolve()
  assert target.is_file(), (str(path),ref)
  links.append(ref)
current=(root/'CURRENT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert current.count('<!-- evaluator-executor-workflow:v2.2 -->')==1
assert 'project_map_revision: r22' in current and 'state: DRAFT_CONTRACT' in current
print(json.dumps({'planning_revision':'r2-long','source_files_unchanged':len(baseline['source_hashes']),'r1_contract_and_plan_preserved':True,'validated_local_links':len(links),'acceptance_criteria':sorted(acs),'validation_checks':len(plan['checks']),'empty_test_suite_cannot_pass_VP02':True,'planned_limits':{'executor_hours':24,'evaluator_hours':6,'public_queries_after_explicit_start':6,'public_document_reads_after_explicit_start':12,'business_api_calls':0},'implementation_started':False,'future_validation_executed':False,'contract_frozen':False,'remaining_dependencies':['explicit_start','one_new_relevant_traceable_permitted_material','source_and_workspace_binding','evaluator_verifier_and_reference_registration']},ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
